integrity: A complete analytic proof and an independently constructed finite checker are supplied. Finite calculations corroborate rather than establish the all-degree statement. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Pure-degree complex spherical harmonics on S^2, equally spaced equatorial sites, one value and one meridional derivative per site with fixed relative Dirichlet normalization; no cumulative-degree or irregular-grid theorem. The originality assessment is bounded to inspected material and is not an independent historical priority certification.
title: Parity-sharp equatorial first-jet sampling and exact conditioning of pure spherical harmonics
